title: Simulation code for a go, adapt or stop progression rule in a small clustered feasibility study
description: Python/NumPy simulations of a pre-specified go, adapt or stop decision rule (80% Wilson intervals widened by a leave-one-school-out check) for 27 teachers in nine schools, with comparisons against eight standard interval methods. Simulated data only; no human data. Result files and run metadata (seeds, versions) included.
